# Requirements Quality Checklist

## Requirement ID Coverage

- [x] All requirements use `REQ-XXX` format.
- [x] IDs are unique and sequential.

## Testability

- [x] Every requirement is independently testable.
- [x] Acceptance criteria are concrete and observable.

## Completeness

- [x] Scope baseline identifies the three requested pages and excluded auth screens.
- [x] User scenarios are prioritized.
- [x] Functional requirements cover the three journeys and shared API contract.
- [x] Success criteria are measurable and user-focused.

## Constitution Alignment

- [x] Mobile-first target and existing API boundary are explicit.
- [x] Secret/config values are excluded from client source and artifacts.
- [x] Existing authentication behavior is explicitly preserved.
